name: DockDoor
tagline: Window peeking and alt-tab functionality for macOS
description: DockDoor brings Window 10-style window previews to your macOS dock. Free, open-source app with intuitive window management. Enhance your Mac workflow.
detailed_description: DockDoor is a free and open-source macOS application designed to enhance the functionality of the Mac Dock by providing window previews and advanced window switching capabilities. It offers a feature similar to Windows, where hovering over a dock icon displays real-time previews of open windows. This tool is particularly useful for users who miss the window preview functionality from Windows or face issues with other similar apps like Dockmate on macOS Sequoia. DockDoor is developed with Swift and SwiftUI, ensuring seamless integration with macOS. It requires accessibility and screen recording permissions to function properly. Despite its benefits, DockDoor has limitations, such as not being able to preview hidden windows or windows on another space due to macOS constraints. Overall, it improves workflow efficiency by allowing users to quickly identify and switch between open windows.

Advanced Window Switching: DockDoor introduces a Ctrl+Tab keyboard shortcut for cycling through all windows open on the current space, making it easier to navigate between multiple windows.
Seamless Integration: Built with Swift and SwiftUI, DockDoor integrates smoothly into the macOS environment, ensuring optimal performance and user experience.
Free and Open Source: Available at no cost, with source code accessible on GitHub, making it accessible to a wide range of users and developers.
Customizable: Users can configure the application via the menu bar icon, allowing for personalized settings to enhance workflow efficiency.
